headline: Fixed: acm.org's server was overloaded; ACM added capacity.
text: Visitors got 'service unavailable' errors from acm.org, but the network path was healthy at every hop. The agents traced it to ACM's server, which could only handle three requests at once and had all three tied up by long bulk downloads from a single source. ACM raised the capacity and restarted; every hop verified the site loads normally again, and a plan to limit the heavy client awaits operator approval.
